items.name: Federated, purpose-bounded essential-service data exchange
items.description: Information sharing across health, education or services using minimized data, independent custody and narrow permitted purposes.
items.mechanism_hypothesis: Minimized exchange may improve continuity and reduce repeated administrative burden; causal effect not established.

items.name: Universal mandatory centralized digital identity
items.description: One centrally managed identity credential required for routine access to specified essential services.
items.mechanism_hypothesis: Some forms of centralized authentication may reduce fraud but could create exclusion, surveillance and correlated failure.

items.name: New federal education funding outcome conditions
items.description: Condition future selected federal education grants on a proposed nationwide reporting and performance regime.
items.mechanism_hypothesis: Could increase comparable evidence while causing compliance cost, privacy risk and federalism issues.

items.name: Proposed federal levy on high-value assets or unrealized appreciation
items.description: Study an additional federal fiscal instrument aimed at highly concentrated wealth, with open thresholds and classification.
items.mechanism_hypothesis: Revenue and distributional effects cannot be asserted until constitutionality, liquidity, administrative costs and behavioral responses are assessed.

items.name: Potential public acquisition of selected critical care facilities
items.description: Compare public acquisition to private, nonprofit, cooperative and mixed improvement alternatives in a specifically evidenced failure market.
items.mechanism_hypothesis: May address access in a particular case but introduces capital, legal, compensation, workforce and quality risks.

items.name: Expanded interagency cyber response with selected defense support
items.description: Study closer crisis coordination for critical services while retaining civilian, private, State and military legal boundaries.
items.mechanism_hypothesis: Could improve response in qualifying contexts but risks overreach, surveillance and unclear civilian command.

items.name: Targeted advanced-manufacturing production incentives
items.description: Consider conditionally funded advanced manufacturing and resilient supply incentives that must demonstrate public value.
items.mechanism_hypothesis: Might diversify strategic supply and skills; could also distort markets, create capture and displace other priorities.

items.name: Voluntary interoperable learning and skills credentials
items.description: Explore portable credentials built around demonstrated learning with learner control and accessible offline alternatives.
items.mechanism_hypothesis: Could help mobility across providers and careers but has privacy, employer-adoption and fairness uncertainties.

items.name: Official content-origin labeling for civic information
items.description: Evaluate a bounded scheme for factual origin, sponsor and authenticity disclosures rather than government judgments about lawful opinion.
items.mechanism_hypothesis: Provenance can support independent assessment; mandatory labels can become de facto political suppression or false confidence.

items.name: Integrated public outcomes information portal
items.description: Publish transparent, privacy-preserving national outcome trends, limitations and responsive public commentary.
items.mechanism_hypothesis: Could strengthen scrutiny, but false precision, sampling exclusions and gaming could undermine trust.
